observations: The new infra note carries 'supersedes: docs/solutions/infra/...-pr2364.md' while its first line says every rule of that note still holds. That is the form skill://legion-retro/references/learnings.md prescribes for a note that corrects one sentence of an existing one, so it is right as written; but skill://legion-oracle and that same reference tell a reader who reaches the old note to 'read that file instead', and the new note does not restate pr2364's three operative rules (mount tmpfs at /var/lib/postgresql and never at the old path; change the image and the mount in one edit; grep the tree for both after each forward merge). A reader who takes 'instead' literally loses them. The note's opening sentence is the only thing holding that together. This is the skill's design rather than this pull request's defect, and it is reported to the architect rather than changed here.

The retro skill names a learning file '<slug>-<LEGION_ISSUE>.md', which on this deployment puts the deployment's Dispatch key into a public file name - the very thing that withdrew this pull request's READY.
